question: What percentage of trees in the Bronx have a health status of Good?
sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN health = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN health IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS percentage_good
FROM trees
WHERE boroname = 'Bronx'
